description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the HL7Service component within the OpenMRS core project, focusing on HL7 message processing, person resolution, location and user ID resolving, and handling of HL7 message parsing errors.

classes.name: HL7ServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing HL7Service functionalities such as message parsing, person and location resolution, and processing HL7 message queues.

methods.name: saveHL7InQueue_shouldAddGeneratedUuidIfUuidIsNull
methods.description: Tests that saving an HL7InQueue without UUID generates a new UUID.

methods.name: processHL7InQueue_shouldCreateHL7InArchiveAfterSuccessfulParsing
methods.description: Verifies that processing a queue item results in an archived HL7 message, stored in an archive directory.

methods.name: processHL7InQueue_shouldCreateHL7InErrorAfterFailedParsing
methods.description: Checks that failed message parsing results in an error record.

methods.name: processHL7InQueue_shouldFailIfGivenInQueueIsAlreadyMarkedAsProcessing
methods.description: Ensures that processing an HL7 queue item marked as processing throws an exception.

methods.name: processHL7Message_shouldSaveHl7MessageToTheDatabase
methods.description: Tests that processing an HL7 message stores it properly and creates observations.

methods.name: parseHL7String_shouldParseTheGivenStringIntoMessage
methods.description: Validates that HL7 string parsing produces a Message object.

methods.name: processHL7Message_shouldParseMessageTypeSuppliedByModule
methods.description: Disabled test for module-defined message parser handling.

methods.name: processHL7InQueue_shouldParseOruR01MessageUsingOverriddenParserProvidedByAModule
methods.description: Disabled test for processing ORU R01 messages with module-overridden parser.

methods.name: resolvePersonFromIdentifiers_shouldFindAPersonBasedOnAPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Tests resolving a Person from identifiers in HL7 NK1 segments by patient identifiers.

methods.name: resolvePersonFromIdentifiers_shouldFindAPersonBasedOnAUUID
methods.description: Tests resolving Person using UUID in NK1 identifiers.

methods.name: resolvePersonFromIdentifiers_shouldFindAPersonBasedOnTheInternalPersonID
methods.description: Tests Person resolution using internal person ID.

methods.name: resolvePersonFromIdentifiers_shouldReturnNullIfNoPersonIsFound
methods.description: Checks that null is returned if no matching person is found.

methods.name: getPersonFromNK1_shouldFailIfAPersonWithTheSameUUIDExists
methods.description: Verifies that creating a Person from NK1 fails if UUID already exists.

methods.name: getPersonFromNK1_shouldFailIfNoBirthdateSpecified
methods.description: Verifies that missing birthdate in NK1 causes failure.

methods.name: getPersonFromNK1_shouldFailIfNoGenderSpecified
methods.description: Verifies failure if gender information is missing.

methods.name: getPersonFromNK1_shouldFailOnAnInvalidGender
methods.description: Checks that invalid gender codes cause failure.

methods.name: getPersonFromNK1_shouldReturnASavedNewPerson
methods.description: Tests successful creation and saving of a new Person from NK1.

methods.name: getPersonFromNK1_shouldReturnAPatientIfValidPatientIdentifiersExist
methods.description: Verifies that NK1 with correct patient identifiers returns a Patient instance.

methods.name: getUuidFromIdentifiers_shouldFindAUUIDInAnyPositionOfTheArray
methods.description: Tests locating UUID in various positions within identifiers array.

methods.name: getUuidFromIdentifiers_shouldReturnNullIfNoUUIDFound
methods.description: Verifies null return when no UUID present.

methods.name: getUuidFromIdentifiers_shouldNotFailIfMultipleSimilarUUIDsExistInIdentifiers
methods.description: Ensures handling multiple similar UUIDs gracefully.

methods.name: getUuidFromIdentifiers_shouldFailIfMultipleDifferentUUIDsExistInIdentifiers
methods.description: Expects exception when conflicting UUIDs exist.

methods.name: getUuidFromIdentifiers_shouldFailIfMultipleDifferentUUIDsExistInIdentifiers
methods.description: Ensures proper exception handling when ambiguous UUIDs are present.

methods.name: getUuidFromIdentifiers_shouldNotFailIfMultipleSimilarUUIDsExistInIdentifiers
methods.description: Tests that similar UUIDs do not cause failure.

methods.name: resolveLocationId_shouldReturnInternalIdentifierOfLocationIfOnlyLocationNameIsSpecified
methods.description: Checks location resolution based on location name only.

methods.name: resolveLocationId_shouldReturnInternalIdentifierOfLocationIfOnlyLocationIdIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests resolution based on specified location ID.

methods.name: resolveLocationId_shouldReturnNullIfLocationIdAndNameAreIncorrect
methods.description: Ensures null is returned for invalid location info.

methods.name: resolveUserId_shouldReturnNullForAmbiguousUsersUsingFirstAndLastNameGivenUserIDIsNull
methods.description: Checks user resolution yields null in ambiguous cases with no user ID.

methods.name: resolveUserId_shouldReturnUserUsingFirstAndLastNameGivenUserIDIsNull
methods.description: Tests user resolution with first and last name when user ID is missing.

methods.name: resolveUserId_shouldReturnUserUsingUsername
methods.description: Verifies user resolution based on username when user ID and full name are given.
